_doc: Boat frame: metres, origin at the static waterline amidships on the centreline, +X forward, +Y PORT, +Z up (Blender). ue_cm = Unreal cm in the boat actor (X fwd, Y = -y: Unreal +Y is STARBOARD, Z up). Seat/hike positions are the PELVIS (hip joint midpoint) of a 1.75 m adult (luch) or the class's crew; feet = between the two ankles; facing = the yaw the torso faces (deg, 0 = forward, +90 = to port). Entries with 'frame' are in that part's own frame (its origin = its pivot, see parts). Side variants: _port / _stbd (sitting on the port / starboard side deck, i.e. starboard / port tack when hiking).

Mast.note: foot of the mast in its step; the mast rotates about its own axis (luch) / is fixed

Boom.note: gooseneck ON THE MAST AXIS; the boom lies along -X; yaw = sheeting angle (+ to port)

Main.note: same pivot as the boom: rotate the sail and the boom together

Rudder.note: on the pintle axis at the waterline; yaw = rudder angle. Blender +yaw (right-handed about +Z) swings the blade's trailing edge to starboard and the tiller to port: the bow turns to starboard. Unreal yaw = -(Blender yaw).

Tiller.note: child of the rudder head; tiller along +X; carries the extension joint at its tip

Ext.note: tiller extension universal joint at the tiller's tip; along +X at rest, swings freely

Board.note: daggerboard at the waterline on the slot's centre; slides along +Z: 0 = fully down, +0.59 = raised half, +1.30 = out

helm_port.note: sitting on the port side deck, facing inboard and forward

helm_stbd.note: sitting on the stbd side deck, facing inboard and forward

hike_port.note: sitting ON the gunwale, thighs on the side deck, torso leaning out to port, feet hooked under the hiking strap

hike_stbd.note: sitting ON the gunwale, thighs on the side deck, torso leaning out to stbd, feet hooked under the hiking strap

strap.note: the strap line (feet go under it, toes up, on the hiking side of it)

mainsheet_block.note: the ratchet block the sheet comes up from (fixed on the hull)

hand_mainsheet.note: front hand holding the sheet 45 cm above the ratchet block (neutral); slide along the line block -> hand toward the helm's shoulder when trimming

hand_tiller_ext.note: aft hand: dagger grip on the extension 6 cm from its end (Ext frame)

hand_tiller.note: a hand on the tiller itself (light airs, the cadet's helm)

boom_block.note: where the mainsheet leaves the boom (Boom frame)

painter.note: bow eye where the painter is made fast / the trolley winch strap hooks

trolley.note: lowest point of the keel: the hull rests on its trolley cradle this far below the waterline
